idea-plugin.name: Bulk Sender Lint
idea-plugin.description:
21 dated checks over SPF, DKIM, DMARC, RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe and TLS, in VS Code and in the browser

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Bulk Sender Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 21 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/bulk-sender-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/bulk-sender-lint

action.text: Bulk Sender Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Bulk Sender Lint on the file in the editor
